_comment: Publish policy for the FreeUnit KB site. One file, so the decision is
reviewable and diffable instead of hidden in the renderer.
areas      which top-level directories are read at all. An area absent
from this list is never opened, which is what keeps strategy/
and team.md out of the build.
root_files loose documents at the KB root that are published.
exclude    slugs dropped after the area check. Two kinds: `slug` for a
path, `subject` for a regex over the document text. This is not
a denylist that guards the private boundary (that is `areas`);
it removes material that is public but off-topic here.
report_only when true, exclusions are listed and nothing is written.

subject.why: Five or more mentions means the document is about the sibling project rather than about FreeUnit. Measured on the 2026-10-12 snapshot: ten documents at 5 or more, the next one at 4.
A reference to the separate Mimic knowledge root, which is not published here.
